content: Cefotetan disodium for injection, marketed under the brand name CEFOTAN, is provided as a sterile, dry powder that ranges in color from white to pale yellow. This powder is available in vials containing cefotetan disodium in quantities equivalent to either 1 gram or 2 grams of cefotetan activity. These vials are intended for both intravenous (IV) and intramuscular (IM) administration. The specific packaging options for the dry powder formulation include the following: 1 g ADD-Vantage Vial (NDC 0310-0376-31) 2 g ADD-Vantage Vial (NDC 0310-0377-32) 1 g Vial (NDC 0310-0376-10) 2 g Vial (NDC 0310-0377-20) 1 g Piggyback Vial (NDC 0310-0376-11) 2 g Piggyback Vial (NDC 0310-0377-21) Additionally, CEFOTAN is available in a pharmacy bulk package containing 10 grams of cefotetan disodium in a 100 mL vial (NDC 0310-0375-10). CEFOTAN is also supplied as a frozen, iso-osmotic, premixed solution for single-dose use. This formulation is provided in Galaxy® plastic containers (PL 2040) and is available in the following configurations: 1 g of cefotetan in a 50 mL plastic container (NDC 0310-0378-51) 2 g of cefotetan in a 50 mL plastic container (NDC 0310-0379-51) The premixed solution in Galaxy® containers must be stored at or below -20°C (-4°F) to maintain its stability and efficacy.
